subject: Physics
title: Units and Measurement
summary: Har physical quantity = number × unit. SI system mein 7 base units hain (m, kg, s, A, K, mol, cd); baaki saare units inhi se derived hain.

Koi measurement perfect nahi hota: least count precision ko limit karta hai, aur errors (systematic, random, gross) accuracy ko. Errors fixed rules se judte hain — sum/difference mein absolute errors jodo, product/quotient mein relative errors jodo, power ho to power se multiply karo.
Significant figures batate hain number kitna precise hai. Calculation ka answer sabse kam precise input se zyada precise nahi ho sakta.

Dimensions quantity ko [M], [L], [T], [A], [K]… mein likhte hain. Dimensional analysis equation check karta hai, units convert karta hai aur relations derive karta hai — par ½, 2π jaise pure-number constants nahi nikaal sakta.

formulas.name: SI base quantities
formulas.formula: length m · mass kg · time s · current A · temperature K · amount mol · luminous intensity cd
formulas.when: Koi bhi unit ya dimension likhte waqt.
formulas.mistake: Plane angle (rad) aur solid angle (sr) dimensionless hain, base units nahi.

formulas.name: Least count of vernier callipers
formulas.formula: LC = 1 MSD − 1 VSD = (value of 1 MSD)/(number of vernier divisions)

formulas.name: Vernier reading
formulas.mistake: Positive zero error ghatao, negative wala jodo — sign ulta mat karo.

formulas.name: Least count of screw gauge
formulas.formula: LC = pitch / (number of circular scale divisions)

formulas.name: Screw gauge reading
formulas.when: Wire ka diameter, sheet ki motai.
formulas.mistake: Circular scale ka zero reference line ke neeche ho to zero error positive hai — ghataane se pehle check karo.

formulas.name: Mean value and absolute error
formulas.formula: a_mean = Σaᵢ/n;  Δaᵢ = |a_mean − aᵢ|;  Δa_mean = Σ|Δaᵢ|/n
formulas.mistake: Har deviation ka modulus lo — errors ko aapas mein cancel mat hone do.

formulas.name: Relative and percentage error
formulas.when: Alag measurements ki precision compare karna.

formulas.name: Errors in sum and difference
formulas.formula: Z = A ± B  ⇒  ΔZ = ΔA + ΔB
formulas.note: Errors hamesha JUDTE hain, chaahe quantities ghataayi ja rahi hon.

formulas.name: Errors in product, quotient and power
formulas.formula: Z = Aᵖ Bᵠ / Cʳ  ⇒  ΔZ/Z = p(ΔA/A) + q(ΔB/B) + r(ΔC/C)
formulas.note: Division mein bhi relative errors judte hain, aur har ek apni power se multiply hota hai.

formulas.name: Significant figure rules
formulas.formula: × and ÷: keep the least number of significant figures;  + and −: keep the least number of decimal places
formulas.mistake: Decimal ke baad trailing zeros gine jaate hain; leading zeros kabhi nahi.

formulas.name: Dimensional formula
formulas.formula: [Q] = [Mᵃ Lᵇ Tᶜ Aᵈ Kᵉ]; e.g. force [MLT⁻²], energy [ML²T⁻²], pressure [ML⁻¹T⁻²]

formulas.name: Principle of homogeneity
formulas.formula: Every term on both sides of a correct equation has the same dimensions
formulas.when: Equation sahi ho sakti hai ya nahi, check karna.
formulas.mistake: Dimensionally sahi equation bhi ½ ya 2π jaise number se galat ho sakti hai.

formulas.name: Unit conversion
formulas.formula: n₁[M₁ᵃ L₁ᵇ T₁ᶜ] = n₂[M₂ᵃ L₂ᵇ T₂ᶜ]  ⇒  n₂ = n₁ (M₁/M₂)ᵃ (L₁/L₂)ᵇ (T₁/T₂)ᶜ
formulas.when: SI se CGS (ya kisi system) mein value badalna.

examples.title: Vernier reading
examples.problem: Vernier ke 10 divisions = main scale ke 9 divisions (1 mm each). Main scale 2.0 cm padhta hai aur 7th vernier division milta hai. Reading? (zero error nahi)

examples.title: Zero error wala screw gauge
examples.problem: Pitch 0.5 mm, 50 circular divisions. Jaws band karne par zero line se 4 divisions neeche. Wire par MSR = 3.0 mm, CSR = 36. Diameter?

examples.title: Pendulum se g mein error
examples.problem: g = 4π²L/T². L mein 2% aur T mein 1% error. g mein maximum % error?

examples.title: Mean absolute error
examples.problem: Time period ki readings: 2.63, 2.56, 2.42, 2.71, 2.80 s. Mean, mean absolute error aur % error?
examples.solution: Mean = 2.62 s. Deviations: 0.01, 0.06, 0.20, 0.09, 0.18 → mean abs error = 0.11 s. % error = 4.1%.

examples.title: G ko CGS mein
examples.problem: G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻². dyne cm² g⁻² mein value? ([G] = M⁻¹L³T⁻²)

examples.title: Product mein significant figures
examples.solution: 3.8 × 2.62 = 9.956; 3.8 mein 2 significant figures hain, isliye answer 10 cm² (1.0 × 10¹ cm² likho).

examples.title: Pendulum formula derive karo
examples.problem: Maano T mass m, length l aur g par T ∝ mᵃ lᵇ gᶜ ki tarah depend karta hai. a, b, c?
examples.solution: [T] = [M]ᵃ[L]ᵇ[LT⁻²]ᶜ → M: a = 0; T: −2c = 1 → c = −½; L: b + c = 0 → b = ½. Isliye T ∝ √(l/g) (2π experiment se aata hai).

topics.title: Base and derived units
topics.explain: Derived units base units se bante hain: newton = kg m s⁻², joule = kg m² s⁻², pascal = kg m⁻¹ s⁻². Prefixes: nano 10⁻⁹, micro 10⁻⁶, milli 10⁻³, kilo 10³, mega 10⁶, giga 10⁹. Practical length units: 1 Å = 10⁻¹⁰ m, 1 fermi = 10⁻¹⁵ m, 1 light year ≈ 9.46 × 10¹⁵ m, 1 AU ≈ 1.5 × 10¹¹ m, 1 parsec ≈ 3.08 × 10¹⁶ m.

topics.title: Accuracy vs precision
topics.explain: Accuracy = true value ke kitna paas. Precision = baar-baar ki readings aapas mein kitni paas (least count se tay). Precise instrument bhi zero error ho to inaccurate ho sakta hai.

topics.title: Types of errors
topics.explain: Systematic errors (instrument ka zero error, kharab method, personal bias) saari readings ek taraf dhakelte hain — behtar method aur correction se kam karo. Random errors anpredictable hote hain — zyada readings lekar average karo. Gross errors laparwahi se aate hain.

topics.title: Rounding off
topics.explain: Last significant digit ke baad ke digits hatao: agla digit > 5 ho to ek badhao; < 5 ho to waisa hi; = 5 ho to last digit even banao (2.745 → 2.74, 2.735 → 2.74). Rounding sirf calculation ke end mein karo.

topics.title: Counting significant figures
topics.explain: Saare non-zero digits gine jaate hain. Non-zero digits ke beech ke zeros bhi (2.005 → 4). Leading zeros kabhi nahi (0.0024 → 2). Trailing zeros sirf decimal point ke saath (2.400 → 4; 2400 ambiguous — 2 ke liye 2.4 × 10³ likho). Exact numbers (2πr ka 2) ke infinite significant figures.

topics.title: Uses and limits of dimensional analysis
topics.explain: Uses: equation check karna, units convert karna, product of powers wala relation derive karna. Limits: ½ ya 2π jaise constants nahi milte, trigonometric/exponential/log relations par fail, sum of terms wali quantity handle nahi hoti, scalar aur vector mein farak nahi batata.

topics.title: Dimensionless and same-dimension quantities
topics.explain: Strain, refractive index, angle, relative density dimensionless hain. Same dimensions: work, energy, torque [ML²T⁻²]; impulse aur momentum [MLT⁻¹]; stress, pressure, Young's modulus, energy density [ML⁻¹T⁻²]; frequency, angular velocity, velocity gradient [T⁻¹]; Planck's constant aur angular momentum [ML²T⁻¹].

topics.title: Common constants ke dimensions
topics.explain: Spring constant k aur surface tension [MT⁻²]; thermal conductivity [MLT⁻³K⁻¹]; Boltzmann constant k_B [ML²T⁻²K⁻¹]; gas constant R [ML²T⁻²K⁻¹mol⁻¹]; specific heat [L²T⁻²K⁻¹]; viscosity η [ML⁻¹T⁻¹]; resistance, reactance aur impedance [ML²T⁻³A⁻²]; capacitance [M⁻¹L⁻²T⁴A²]; inductance [ML²T⁻²A⁻²]; ε₀ [M⁻¹L⁻³T⁴A²]; μ₀ [MLT⁻²A⁻²]; magnetic field B [MT⁻²A⁻¹]. Koi bhi defining formula se nikal lo: k = F/x, K ke liye Q/t = KAΔT/L, k_B = E/T, R = V/I.

topics.title: Experimental skills
topics.explain: Vernier callipers internal aur external diameter aur depth naapte hain; screw gauge wire ka diameter aur sheet ki motai LC 0.01 mm se. Naapne se pehle jaws band karke zero error note karo, kai jagah reading lo aur average karo.

ratta: 7 SI base units: m, kg, s, A, K, mol, cd.
Vernier LC = MSD/N;  screw gauge LC = pitch/N.
Corrected reading = observed − zero error (sign included).
Sums: add absolute errors;  products/powers: add (power × relative error).
× ÷ → least significant figures;  + − → least decimal places.
Force MLT⁻², energy ML²T⁻², pressure ML⁻¹T⁻², h ML²T⁻¹, G M⁻¹L³T⁻².
Dimensional analysis can't give constants like 2π.
k (spring) MT⁻²;  thermal conductivity MLT⁻³K⁻¹;  k_B ML²T⁻²K⁻¹;  R, X_L, X_C ML²T⁻³A⁻².
